solution_ladder.L1_patch: Patch each output string independently in the six affected callers and keep string rules duplicated.
solution_ladder.L2_abstraction: Centralize task-reference formatting in a helper while keeping caller-side source detection local.
solution_ladder.L3_operating_surface: Introduce a broader session-awareness surface or persistent UX layer for task targeting.

layer_justification: The task-source rule repeats across emit, status, history, and compiled-output surfaces, so a shared formatter is the highest useful layer that stays bounded to existing CLI formatting code.
why_not_lower: An L1 patch would duplicate the same session suffix rule across multiple callsites and make future output adjustments drift-prone.
why_not_higher: An L3 operating surface would add UI or state machinery that the request explicitly excludes and that is unnecessary for this human-output fix.
